name: Guddi
description: Guddi looks up to Inspector Anuj, who is also engaged to her favourite teacher Shirin. What happens when she finds herself stuck between the two?

videos.title: Anuj's Birthday Prep
videos.overview: Shirin and Chaitali plan to celebrate Anuj's birthday and want to invite his family. While Mamoni prepares for the birthday, Keyaful gives an offer to Guddi.
